summary.text: Julie Kerton is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 107, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Marty Foncello. She is a realtor and chairs the Brookfield Board of Assessment Appeals.

paragraphs.text: According to a Ballotpedia survey, Julie Kerton has lived in Brookfield for 35 years, and her children attended the Brookfield public schools.
She has served on the Brookfield Board of Assessment Appeals for a decade and currently chairs it, and she works as a realtor.
The 2026 Democratic primary for District 107 was canceled.
Kerton listed affordability, particularly housing, and education and health care among her key messages, and said she would protect and fund public schools, community colleges and state universities.
